notes.title: Patch Notes - August 7th, 2024
notes.content:
Welcome to today's patch notes! This build introduces a community-requested change and fixes an annoying bug.

[list]
[*] Add config option allowing you to mute the game when it is unfocused
[*] The game now mutes on focus loss by default
[*] Fix issue where items could be picked up during dialogue, sometimes leading to the mouse disappearing.
[/list]

Thanks for reading!

tags.feature: [*] Add config option allowing you to mute the game when it is unfocused

tags.bug: [*] Fix issue where items could be picked up during dialogue, sometimes leading to the mouse disappearing.

notes.title: Patch Notes - August 2, 2024
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to today's patch notes!

[list]
[*] Fix issue preventing High Score Mode and Time Attack Mode from working as intended
[*] Fix inconsistent audio leveling issue
[*] Miscellaneous bug fixes
[/list]

We are aware that the arcade modes do not currently have end screens. We are hoping to add those soon, along with high score tracking! Thank you for your patience while we work to improve the game!

We appreciate any and all feedback. Send us feedback directly via our [url=https://discord.gg/8uWduVrUUa]Discord[/url] or email us!

tags.bug: [*] Fix issue preventing High Score Mode and Time Attack Mode from working as intended
